visual_observations: All four use matching real font/vector readouts behind separate screen lenses, with visible breathing/scan modulation and no raster-text breakup.
The glass HUD is smaller, inset behind the pane and follows its curvature; full frost now naturally obscures it.
B and C console assemblies fill the measured inner bezels and cover the previous garbled artwork. D status clears its source rail on a supported pad.
Glass has a visible cold cyan veil and stronger grazing response; the subject remains visible. The black review environment gives limited central reflections.
All nine bottom consoles were inspected in closeup. Original frame irregularities and some faceted dark seating rims remain visible at extreme close range, particularly A and D.
C retains four-sided glazing, visible internal fog and contained tail. Original structural posts still obscure parts of the silhouette.
All four native cycles show downward jets, complete frost and normal restoration. Observed reset times are 4.003-4.039 seconds; repeat/range/visibility guards pass.
Fine frost grain remains; dark top/rear views do not prove every fine contact. Physical-input feel, packaged load time, resident VRAM and GPU performance are unmeasured.

quality_by_candidate.A: Smallest static budget. Clear silhouette and readable fitted screens; source metal/suit details are softer than D. Some close-range seating-rim facets remain.
quality_by_candidate.B: Clean refitted screens and curved glass HUD; the original body detail remains softer despite its 8K base texture. Higher texture tier than A/C.
quality_by_candidate.C: Best candidate for a view from every side: four continuous glass sectors, cyan-lit fog and contained tail. Original ribs obscure parts of the hero; both consoles now fill the bezels.
quality_by_candidate.D: Strongest hero-detail candidate: clearer fur, suit, hoses and chamber trim. Three clean console faces and supported status display. Highest static mesh budget and the 8K texture tier.

unverified: Packaged load time, GPU frame time and resident VRAM
